name: Kevin Medeiros
intro: I'm Kevin Medeiros — 9+ years designing, automating and operating resilient cloud platforms on AWS, GCP and Kubernetes, with a focus on GitOps, observability and cost.
about: I turn sprawling infrastructure into calm, automated systems — the boring kind of reliability, the kind nobody notices because nothing breaks.
My work centers on migrating services into containerized environments, GitOps automation and observability. I also build with Python, and I've led and mentored engineering teams along the way.
I founded GanhaLic and Ligado em IA.
